ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the figure: In the figure, it can be seen that Y, S, W are on the same horizontal line; XY is a vertical segment downward from Y; P, S, Q are on the same vertical line; R, Q are on the same horizontal line; Q is located on the lower slanted line XW; R, Y, P are located on the upper slanted line PR, and the problem gives PR ∥ WX. Then reason: According to the specified coordinate method, let Y=(0,0), W=(8,0). Because XY is vertical and XY=6, X=(0,-6). At this time WX=sqrt(8^2+6^2)=10, consistent with the problem. The slope of line XW is 6/8=3/4, so the slope of PR parallel to it is also 3/4. Since RY=5, and along the 3-4-5 direction from Y down-left to R, R=(-4,-3). The horizontal line through R is y=-3, and it intersects XW at Q. The equation of line XW is y=(3/4)x-6. Let y=-3, giving -3=(3/4)x-6, so x=4, Q=(4,-3). The vertical line through Q intersects YW at S=(4,0). Also PS=3, and P is above S, so P=(4,3). Therefore PQ is the vertical distance from y=3 to y=-3, PQ=3-(-3)=6.

Put Y=(0,0), W=(8,0), and because XY is vertical with XY=6, put X=(0,-6). Then WX=sqrt(8^2+6^2)=10, consistent with the text. The lower slanted line XW has slope 6/8=3/4, so the parallel upper line PR has the same slope. Since RY=5 along this 3-4-5 direction, R is 4 units left and 3 units down from Y, so R=(-4,-3). The horizontal line through R has y=-3; its intersection with XW gives Q=(4,-3). The vertical through Q meets YW at S=(4,0), and PS=3 places P=(4,3). Therefore PQ is the vertical distance from y=3 to y=-3, giving PQ=6.

method.method_draft: Use similar right-triangle/proportional-length reasoning without coordinates. From the image, XY is perpendicular to YW, and XW is the slanted side parallel to PR. The given XY=6, WY=8, WX=10 shows triangle XYW is a 6-8-10 right triangle, so along any segment parallel to XW the vertical-to-horizontal-to-slanted ratio is 6:8:10 = 3:4:5. Since RY lies on PR and PR || WX, the length RY=5 corresponds to the scaled 3-4-5 triangle: moving from R to Y raises 3 units vertically and moves 4 units horizontally. Thus the horizontal line through R and Q is 3 units below the horizontal line through Y and S, so SQ=3. From the diagram P,S,Q are collinear vertically and PS=3. Hence PQ=PS+SQ=3+3=6.
